Title: Acoustic Characteristics of Top Billboard Songs By: Ava Ortiz, Yu Yan, Jay Mirman, Martha Miller

We will be exploring features of songs that cause them to have the highest popularity score.
Looking at trends for the specific areas that tend to do well on the Spotify Index

We chose this project because of the popularity of Spotify for our generation and our interest in learning about acoustic characteristics of songs.

Research Question: Is there a relationship between the Spotify popularity and audio characteristics of songs?
